items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Hello, Bud D. Well, it was last week, man.

ctx.x: No, I never did. There was another guy called Johnny Lolliver. Nobody knew nothing about him. He was a hell of a trumpet player. I heard of him. There was nobody. There was nobody. Did you know? Somebody played a whole lot of horn. He was running to go to Richard Times and his daddy owned a half of French Mophage. Hey George.
Hello, Bud D. Well, it was last week, man.
How's that? He came in the other door, you noticed.
